pages.text: The $(item)Armory Cabinet$() is a two-block-tall bulk-storage block that accepts only $(thing)weapons, tools, armour, and arrows$() — items with durability or tagged as equipment. It holds up to $(bold)1,024 items$() and connects to the $(l:network/network_interface)item network$().

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() either half of the cabinet to open the storage UI. Items without durability (plain blocks, food, books, etc.) are rejected.$(br2)Connect the cabinet to a tube to make it part of the network, which makes it easy to route output from automated smelters, crafters, or enchanting setups directly into organised equipment storage.

pages.title: No Upgrades
pages.text: The Armory Cabinet does not accept any upgrades. Its capacity is fixed at 1,024 items and cannot be increased.
